newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EC REPORT LONG-TERM DIARY FOR JAN 13 - DEC 31, 1997.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EC REPORT LONG-TERM DIARY FOR JAN 13 - DEC 31, 1997.

text.p: HIGHLIGHTS
AMSTERDAM - Dutch presidency hosts European Council of heads of state or government (June 16-17).
MADRID - NATO holds summit to set the course for enlargement (July 8 and 9).
LUXEMBOURG - Luxembourg presidency hosts European Council of heads of state or government (December 12-13).
MONDAY, JANUARY 13
STRASBOURG - European Parliament holds plenary session (To January 17).
Provisional agenda includes:
- (1800/1700 GMT) Constitutent session: announcement of election candidates by the oldest EP deputy ("doyen d'age").
TUESDAY, JANUARY 14
BRUSSELS - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting.
Provisional agenda includes:
- European Commissioner Bjerregaard communication on environmental responsibilities - orientation debate.
STRASBOURG - European Parliament holds plenary session (second of five days).
Provisional agenda includes:
- (1000/0900 GMT) Election of President.
- (1200/1100 GMT) Election of Vice-President.
- (1500/1400 GMT) (possibly) Continuation of Presidential election.
- (1800/1700 GMT) (possibly) Continuation of Vice-Presidential election.
- (2000/1900 GMT) Election or continuation of administrative officers' elections.
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 15
STRASBOURG - European Parliament holds plenary session (third of five days).
Provisional agenda includes:
- (possibly) Continuation of administrative officers' elections.
- Elected president gives address.
- (1000/0900 GMT) Joint debate:
- Council report and Commission statement on the Dublin European Council.
- Council statement on the Irish Presidency.
- Singapore WTO ministerial meeting.
- (1230/1130 GMT) Votes on:
- The number and size of parliamentary committees.
- Dublin European Council.
- Bernard Kouchner report on the fourth ACP/EU Lome Convention protocol following accession of Austria, Finland and Sweden.
- (possibly) Continuation of administrative officers' elections.
- (1500/1400 GMT) (possibly) Continuation of administrative officers' elections.
- Council declaration on the Dutch presidency work programme.
- Ria Oomen-Ruijten report on long distance sales contracts.
- Dagmar Roth-Behrendt report on novel foods and ingredients.
- Karla Peijs report on cross-border transfers.
- Jan Willem Bertens report on EU/ Latin America relations: perspectives for 1996-2000 partnership strengthening.
- Carlos Carnero Gonzalez report on the renewal of the San Jose dialogue with Central America.
- Manuel Medina Ortega recommendation on the protection of personal data.
- Petrus Cornelissen report on air traffic management.
- Frits Castricum report on public services and state aids to transport.
- (1900/1800 GMT) Communication of the presidents' conference proposals for the nomination of parliamentary committees and inter-parliamentary committees.
BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - Committee of the Regions holds plenary session (To January 16).
Provisional agenda includes:
- (1700/1600 GMT) Portuguese President Jorge Sampaio gives address.
- (1830/1730 GMT) Spatial planning in Europe.
- Communication on the implementation of EU regional policies in Austria, Finland and Sweden, COM(96)316.
- The global challenge of international trade: a market access strategy for the EU, COM(96)53.
- Communication from the Commission: universal service for telecoms in the perspective of a fully liberalised environment, COM(96)73.
BRUSSELS - Committee of the Regions holds forum on "Information for citizens" (To January 16).
THURSDAY, JANUARY 16
STRASBOURG - European Parliament holds plenary session (fourth of five days).
Provisional agenda includes:
- (1000/0900 GMT) Willy De Clercq report on EU/Israel agreements on public procurement and telecoms markets.
- Peter Kittelmann report on mutual recognition of approvals of motor vehicle equipment and parts - adhesion to 1958 accord.
- Winfried Menrad report on workers' information and consultation.
- Carmen Fraga Estevez report on the conservation of fisheries resources in the Mediterranean.
- Ken Collins report on the protection against atmospheric pollution and forest fires.
- David Edward Thomas report on global Community strategy in the forestry sector.
- Diemud Theato report on the change of the legal basis to the proposal for a regulation on customs and farming mutual recognition

- (1200/1100 GMT) Votes on the presidents' conference proposals for the nomination of parliamentary committees and inter-parliamentary committees and on reports under cooperation, codecision and assent procedures and on other motions for resolutions on which debate has closed.
- (1700/1600 GMT) Constitution of parliamentary committees.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Committee of the Regions holds plenary session (second of two days).
Provisional agenda includes:
- (0900/0800 GMT) European Commissioner Fischler gives address.
- (0945/0845 GMT) The CAP and eastward enlargement.
- A rural development policy.
- The role of local and regional authorities in public service, COM(96)443.

- Green paper: towards fair and efficient pricing in transport - policy options for internalising the external cost of transport in the EU. Proposal for Council directive on the charging of heavy goods vehicles for the use of certain infrastructures, COM(95)691.
- Report on the consideration of cultural aspects in European Community action, COM(96)160.
- Communication from the Commission on the review of the Community strategy for waste management, COM(96)399.
- (1430/1330 GMT) European Commissioner Oreja gives address.
- Green paper: living and working in the information society - people first, COM(96)389.
- Commission communication: learning in the information society - action plan for a European education initiative (1996-1998), COM(96)471.
- Proposal for an EP and Council decision laying down a series of guidelines on trans-European energy networks, COM(96)390.
- The role of local and regional authorities in linking education and training establishments to enterprises.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - The American Chamber of Commerce (AMCHAM) and The Belgium-Japan Association and Chamber of Commerce (BJA) hold joint dinner with European Monetary Institute President Alexandre Lamfalussy on "Towards Monetary Union in 1999" (2000/1900 GMT). Venue: Conrad Hotel. Contact: Sheila Chabeau, AMCHAM (322) 513 6770.
FRIDAY, JANUARY 17
STRASBOURG - European Parliament holds plenary session (last of five days).
Provisional agenda includes:
- Graham Mather report on narrowing of dispositions related to the index declaration.
- Votes on:
- Any procedures without reports;
- Jutta Haug report without debate;
- Proposals for resolutions on which the debate is closed.
- Reports under article 97.
- Helene Carrere D'Encausse on development of EU-Transcaucasus relations.
- Giulio Fantuzzi report on the protection of geographical indications and labels of origin.
MONDAY, JANUARY 20

BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - Farm Council (To January 21).
Provisional agenda includes:
- (possibly) Reform of the common market organisation for olive oil - Commission presentation.
- Report on the common organisation of the tobacco market - Commission presentation, COM(96)554.
- (possibly) Proposal for Council regulation modifying regulation 1765/92 instituting a support system for certain arable crops producers.
- Proposal for Council regulation:

- Modifying regulation 1873/84 authorising the supply and shipping, for direct human consumption, of certain imported wines likely to have been the subject of oenological practices not foreseen in regulation 822/87;
- Modifying regulation 2390/89 establishing general regulations on wine, juices and must imports.
- Proposal for Council regulations:
- Establishing an identification and registration system for beef;
- On labelling of beef and beef products.
- Proposal for Council regulation modifying regulation 619/71 fixing general rules for granting aid to linen and jute.
- Proposal for Council regulation modifying regulation 2328/91 on the improvement in the efficiency of farming structures.
- State of work of the negotiations with third countries for the conclusion of veterinary and plant health equivalence accords.
- Adoption in Community languages of Council directive on the modification and update of directive 64/432/EEC on sanitary police problems in intra-Community beef and pig exchanges.
- Adoption in Community languages of Council directive modifying directive 91/629/EEC establishing minimum standards for protection of calves.

- Adoption in Community languages of Council directive modifying directive 77/93/EEC on protective measures against the introduction into member states of harmful organisms in vegetables or vegetable products.
